asked.item: Which template for a made-up person talking to camera selfie style

verdict.reason: The pages say to select "AI Selfie Talking Video with Consistent Character" for a generated character talking to the camera, and where to find it.

steps.text: Select "AI Selfie Talking Video with Consistent Character" for a generated character video.
This template is for AI-generated character videos, not your real face, where a character "talks to the camera" in a POV, vlog, or first-person style.
